prompt: Write the note left under a windshield wiper after backing into a truck in the church parking lot. It must fully accept responsibility, contain a working phone number format, quote Scripture appropriately, and still somehow preserve your dignity. Four constraints. All of them.
response:
I’m so sorry—I backed into your truck in the church parking lot and take full responsibility for the damage. I should have been more careful, and I want to make it right.

Please call or text me at (555) 267-9148 so we can exchange insurance information and handle this properly.

“Whoever walks in integrity walks securely” — Proverbs 10:9. I intend to do that here.

Again, my apologies. Accidents happen, but leaving without owning it isn’t who I want to be.

— [Your Name]
